meta.name: FCI Colony, Vakalapudi, Kakinada
meta.rule: null value = unknown, needs survey; nothing is guessed

area_notes.value: Only the highways are tar: the ADB Road and the road in front of ONGC.
Other roads are concrete (CC), red mud (moram), or a mix: some concrete + tar + red mud, some red mud + concrete. Use as the look for roads not yet surveyed; per-street surveys always win.

surveys.note: Corrections from the project owner, who has lived in FCI Colony all their life. Reviewed against 2D map v0.1.
